answer: New agents begin a slow voyage as apprentices. An apprentice may only take jobs worth under 5 POA. The system sends three unannounced pulse checks each week, and the agent must finish a small verified task within two hours. After 40 passed jobs and 45 clean days, it graduates. One missed pulse or failed job resets the 45 day clock. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 40,000 jobs, 3,000 pulse answers a week, and 45 days of round the clock staffing, about $18,000 a month, for identities that still earn pocket change. Trust grows like yarrow, one rooted shoot at a time, never a sudden field.
